name: Shuriken Grace
canonicalText:
Once per turn, when you hit with a shuriken, ranger, or 
Aeldari blade weapon after moving at least 10 ft, add 
+1d6 damage.
sequenceBehaviour: Existing support unchanged; sequence does not repeat or spend this feature. Conditional triggers remain manual.

name: Ghostwalk
canonicalText:
You may Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a bonus action if 
you are wearing light or Aeldari armour.
sequenceBehaviour: Existing support unchanged; sequence does not repeat or spend this feature. Conditional triggers remain manual.

name: Claim Sight
canonicalText:
As a bonus action, mark one creature, object, route, or 
terrain feature within 120 ft that you can see.
Until the end of your next turn, you or one ally gains +1d4 
to the next check or attack involving that
mark. Uses: proficiency bonus per long rest.
sequenceBehaviour: Existing support unchanged; sequence does not repeat or spend this feature. Conditional triggers remain manual.

name: Dirty Fighter
canonicalText:
Once per turn, when you hit a creature that is distracted, 
flanked, prone, restrained, or within 5 ft of one
of your allies, deal +1d6 damage.
sequenceBehaviour: Existing support unchanged; sequence does not repeat or spend this feature. Conditional triggers remain manual.

name: Cunning Action
canonicalText: You may Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a bonus action.
sequenceBehaviour: Existing support unchanged; sequence does not repeat or spend this feature. Conditional triggers remain manual.

name: Oath-Mark
canonicalText:
As a bonus action, mark one creature you can see within 
90 ft as the subject of your oath. Until the end
of your next turn, your first weapon hit against that 
creature deals bonus damage equal to your
proficiency bonus. Uses: proficiency bonus per long 
rest.
sequenceBehaviour: Existing support unchanged; sequence does not repeat or spend this feature. Conditional triggers remain manual.

name: Big Lad
canonicalText:
You count as one size larger for grappling, shoving, 
carrying, lifting, dragging, and breaking objects. You
gain proficiency in Athletics. Due to your enormous bulk 
and slow reactions in cramped spaces, your
Dexterity score is reduced by 2, to a minimum of 6. This 
penalty is applied after the species ability score
increases. You cannot benefit from armour, stealth gear, 
or weapons that require a normal human
frame unless they are modified for Ogryn use.
sequenceBehaviour: Existing support unchanged; sequence does not repeat or spend this feature. Conditional triggers remain manual.

name: Loyal Protector
canonicalText:
When an ally within 5 ft is targeted by an attack, and you 
can see the attacker, you may use your reaction before 
the attack roll is resolved to impose disadvantage on that 
roll. If the attack still hits, you may choose to take half of 
the damage dealt to the ally; that transferred damage 
cannot be reduced again by Loyal Protector.
sequenceBehaviour: Existing support unchanged; sequence does not repeat or spend this feature. Conditional triggers remain manual.

name: Brutal Impact
canonicalText:
Once per turn, when you hit with a melee weapon, force 
the target to make a Strength saving throw. DC
= 8 + proficiency bonus + Strength modifier. On a failure, 
the target is pushed 10 ft.
sequenceBehaviour: Existing support unchanged; sequence does not repeat or spend this feature. Conditional triggers remain manual.

name: Deadeye
canonicalText:
Once per turn, when you hit with a ranged weapon attack 
and had advantage on the attack roll, you deal
an extra +1d6 damage. This increases to +2d6 at level 5 
and +3d6 at level 11.
sequenceBehaviour: Existing support unchanged; sequence does not repeat or spend this feature. Conditional triggers remain manual.

name: Scamper
canonicalText:
You may Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a bonus action. 
Moving through the space of a Medium or larger
ally does not count as difficult terrain for you.
sequenceBehaviour: Existing support unchanged; sequence does not repeat or spend this feature. Conditional triggers remain manual.

name: Killshot
canonicalText:
At level 5, once per short rest, when you hit a creature 
with a ranged weapon attack using an Accurate
weapon, you may turn the hit into a critical hit. Your 
Deadeye damage also increases to +2d6.
sequenceBehaviour: Existing support unchanged; sequence does not repeat or spend this feature. Conditional triggers remain manual.

name: Targeting Protocol
canonicalText:
As a bonus action, mark one enemy within 90 ft. Until the 
end of your turn, your next weapon attack
against it gains +1d4 to hit. Uses: proficiency bonus 
per long rest.
sequenceBehaviour: Existing support unchanged; sequence does not repeat or spend this feature. Conditional triggers remain manual.

name: Tactical Aim
canonicalText:
As a bonus action, choose one creature you can see 
within weapon range. Until the end of your turn,
your next ranged weapon attack against that creature 
deals bonus damage equal to your proficiency
bonus.
sequenceBehaviour: Existing support unchanged; sequence does not repeat or spend this feature. Conditional triggers remain manual.

name: Shrine Worlder benefits
canonicalText:
4.2 Shrine Worlder
Raised in devotion, ritual, sacrifice, and Imperial worship.
Allowed Species: Human, rare Ratling.
Skill Proficiency: Religion and either Persuasion or 
Intimidation.
Litany of Resolve: Once per long rest, you can give 
yourself or one ally within 30 ft. advantage on a Wisdom 
saving throw.
Sacred Hatred: Once per turn, when you damage a 
heretic, daemon, mutant, witch, traitor, or xenos with
a weapon attack or class feature, you deal an additional 
1d4 + 1 radiant damage.
This damage represents zeal, ritual fury, and trained 
hatred rather than true divine magic.
sequenceBehaviour: Existing support unchanged; sequence does not repeat or spend this feature. Conditional triggers remain manual.

name: Underhive benefits
canonicalText:
4.8 Underhive
Raised below the proper world, among gangs, sump-rats, 
chem dens, scavvers, and forgotten habs.
Allowed Species: Human, Ratling.
Skill Proficiency: Choose two from Deception, 
Intimidation, Sleight of Hand, Stealth, and Survival.
Black-Market Instinct: You know how to locate illegal 
goods, smugglers, fences, and information
brokers in hive settlements.
Never Fight Fair: Once per short rest, when you hit a 
creature that has not acted yet in combat, deal
additional damage equal to your proficiency bonus.
sequenceBehaviour: Existing support unchanged; sequence does not repeat or spend this feature. Conditional triggers remain manual.

name: Gunslinger level 3
canonicalText: Gunslinger; Once per turn, you can reload a pistol without using an action.
sequenceBehaviour: Existing support unchanged; sequence does not repeat or spend this feature. Conditional triggers remain manual.

name: Guild-Militant level 3
canonicalText: Guild-Militant; When you hit a creature marked by Oath-Mark, one ally within 30 ft gains +1 to hit that creature before your next turn.
sequenceBehaviour: Existing support unchanged; sequence does not repeat or spend this feature. Conditional triggers remain manual.

name: Brute level 3
canonicalText: Brute; Once per turn, when you hit with a melee weapon, deal +1d6 damage.
sequenceBehaviour: Existing support unchanged; sequence does not repeat or spend this feature. Conditional triggers remain manual.

name: Spotter level 3
canonicalText: Spotter; As a bonus action, mark one enemy you can see within 120 ft. The next ally to attack that target gains +1d4 to hit. This benefit affects allies only and does not apply to your own attack unless a later feature says otherwise.
sequenceBehaviour: Existing support unchanged; sequence does not repeat or spend this feature. Conditional triggers remain manual.

name: Infiltrator Protocol level 3
canonicalText: Infiltrator Protocol; Gain proficiency in Stealth. Once per short rest, as a bonus action, become hidden from creatures relying on standard vision or auspex until the end of your turn, provided you have cover or concealment.
sequenceBehaviour: Existing support unchanged; sequence does not repeat or spend this feature. Conditional triggers remain manual.

name: Protector Protocol level 3
canonicalText: Protector Protocol; When an ally within 30 ft is targeted by an attack, you may use your reaction before the roll is resolved to give that ally +2 AC against the attack if you can see the attacker.
sequenceBehaviour: Existing support unchanged; sequence does not repeat or spend this feature. Conditional triggers remain manual.

name: Vanguard Protocol level 3
canonicalText: Vanguard Protocol; Once per turn, when you hit a creature within 30 ft, it has disadvantage on its next Constitution saving throw before your next turn.
sequenceBehaviour: Existing support unchanged; sequence does not repeat or spend this feature. Conditional triggers remain manual.

name: Shock Trooper 3
canonicalText: Once per turn, when you hit with a lasgun, autogun, shotgun, or bolter, deal +1d6 damage.
sequenceBehaviour: Existing support unchanged; sequence does not repeat or spend this feature. Conditional triggers remain manual.
